entry_thesis: AST SpaceMobile is the #1 conviction play on WallStreetBets 2026 Index with massive retail following, and just announced a landmark commercial agreement with TELUS for a space-based cellular broadband network in Canada on March 3 — a fresh catalyst driving the stock from $79 (Feb 27) to $105 today. Retail sentiment is at peak enthusiasm with multiple analyst upgrades (Roth Capital $108 PT, Deutsche Bank $139 PT, UBS raising to $85+), while broader market Fear & Greed Index sitting in Fear territory (~35-44) provides a 'fearful market, greedy individual stock' sentiment divergence that historically amplifies breakout moves on strong catalysts.
risk: Tariff/trade policy headwinds could disrupt satellite supply chain (company itself flagged this on March 3), and the stock is up ~33% in a week making it vulnerable to profit-taking if the broader fear environment worsens.
catalyst: TELUS commercial partnership announcement (March 3) triggering analyst upgrades and retail FOMO; upcoming satellite launch milestones and Space Development Agency contract creating near-term narrative momentum
